tasks.description: In docs/docs/hive.md, under the '#### Schema evolution' section, add a note that Hive Metastore compatibility can affect Iceberg schema-evolution operations (e.g. column rename/type-change/reorder constraints imposed by the HMS version), and reference the supported HMS versions (Hive 2.3.10 or 3.1.3 or later) already stated in the Global Hive catalog section.

In docs/docs/evolution.md, in the '## Schema evolution' section, add a brief caveat that when tables are managed through a Hive Metastore catalog, HMS version compatibility can constrain or affect schema-evolution operations, linking to the Hive docs page for details.
